Geotechnical_Definition: Unique test code for experimental series
Key referencing dataset_sources.csv
Type of foundation: DPRF / CPR / UR
1 if disconnected via cushion; 0 if connected (CPR)
Number of piles underneath the raft
Model pile outer diameter (d)
Model pile embedded length (L)
Normalized pile center-to-center spacing (s/d)
Square model raft width (B)
Model raft plate thickness (t_r)
Ratio of total pile area to raft area (n_p * pi * d^2 / 4) / B^2
Normalized cushion thickness (h/d). 0 for CPR/UR
Mean grain size (d_50) of the cushion layer. 0 if no cushion
Peak internal friction angle of granular cushion material
Compacted dry unit weight of cushion layer
Mean grain size of bed soil (Yamuna sand = 0.3mm)
Friction angle of foundation bed soil
Relative density (Dr) of sand bed
Dry unit weight of soil bed
Total vertical load applied to raft (Q)
Measured vertical settlement at raft center (w)
Settlement normalized by raft width (w/B * 100)
Applied vertical stress on raft footprint (Q / B^2)
Percentage of total load carried by piles (alpha_p * 100)
Percentage of total load carried by raft (alpha_r * 100)
Total load carried by pile group (Q_p)
Total load carried by raft (Q_r)
Dimensionless settlement reduction: (w_UR - w_DPRF) / w_UR
